description:
Connect ChatGPT to your Butiksoft hotel management system to manage day-to-day hotel operations. Check reservations and availability, review guest and room information, manage reservations, access operational data, and perform supported hotel management tasks directly through ChatGPT.

Butiksoft securely connects to your existing account and respects your property’s user permissions, allowing you to access and manage only the information and operations you are authorized to use.

defaultPrompt: Create a 3-night reservation for John Doe, c-in on August 25 $100 per night. Add reminder for “TK3200 Shuttle” on Agu 25.
Analyze availability for next week and develop an action plan.
Create an email using one of my templates for new reservations received in the last 24 hours.
